problem.exists: A CDS cell's whole task specification is one free-text goal line.
problem.expected: A CDS cell carries a structured issue, and both seats receive the same frozen copy.
problem.diverges: Nothing in either authority can tell a well-formed issue from an empty string.

sources.claim: the CDS issue type and its admission predicate
the CUE authority for the same issue

in: a typed issue admitted identically by Go and CUE
both CDS seats rendering one issue through one renderer

acceptance.statement: Go and CUE accept and reject the same issue documents.
acceptance.verification: go test ./internal/cdsissue/... and ./scripts/cell-schema-check.sh read one shared fixture corpus

acceptance.statement: Both seats are shown a byte-identical issue block.
acceptance.verification: a Go test renders both prompts from one contract and compares the issue blocks

design.approach: Carry the issue and the design in one run input document, separate from the reusable cell spec, admit both structurally before anything cognitive is constructed, and freeze the admitted bytes into the contract the kernel already digests.
invariants: the kernel learns nothing about issues, designs, or git
no provider is invoked before admission passes
the subject is pinned exactly once, before either seat is constructed

impact.why: the structural admission arm and the outcome vocabulary live here
three opaque contract slots ride the frozen contract into the one scope-lift digest
